external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app, either as an admin or a viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer.
external_entities.notes: Signs in with an email address and password, receives a session cookie, and has no second factor.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The recipient of an invoice email who can open the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
external_entities.notes: The payment page asks the payer to sign in to nothing.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console from the support office network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent signs in with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users, payers, support agents, and the PDF workflow.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: Uses one database account for all companies and one service credential to fetch PDFs from the bucket.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: The console from which support agents can open sessions in the billing app as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The database has no row-level security. How it is protected at rest was not recorded.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs containing a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue
data_stores.notes: How the queue is reached was not recorded.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared cloud bucket containing rendered invoice PDFs under company IDs and invoice numbers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: one PDF bucket in our cloud platform
data_stores.notes: How the bucket is reached and protected at rest was not recorded.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user uses the billing app in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie; no second factor
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer information, payout bank details, and account actions

data_flows.name: open payment page
data_flows.description: A payer follows an invoice link and views the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.notes: The payer is not required to sign in.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and payout bank details

data_flows.name: send invoice email
data_flows.description: The billing app sends an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number to the payer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link containing the invoice number

data_flows.name: read and write invoices
data_flows.description: The billing app reads and writes tenant records in the PostgreSQL database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, company IDs, user actions, and invoice fields

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.notes: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID carried by the job.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice selected using the company ID and invoice number from the job

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes the rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF, company ID, and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: One service credential is used for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: sign in to console
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console from the support office network.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Administrator credentials and console session

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as a customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Actions are recorded against the customer user rather than the support agent.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session and actions performed in the billing app

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform hosting the shared billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: support office
trust_boundaries.description: The support office network from which the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: A customer company's tenant context in which its people and data are associated.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database is confidential because it contains invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The render queue is confidential because its jobs contain company IDs and invoice numbers that identify business records.
assumptions.basis: The source states that each render job carries a company ID and an invoice number.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket is confidential because it stores rendered invoice PDFs containing financial and customer information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the renderer writes invoice PDFs to the PDF bucket, and the payment page exposes invoice and bank-detail information.
